title: Implement Full-Text Search: From Index to Results Page | Orchard Core
description:
A website search needs an index, a setting that picks it, a permission that lets visitors query it, and a results page.

This guide builds each part with the Lucene and Search features of Orchard Core. It then changes what is indexed with a Liquid template in the Full-text section of a content type, changes the results page with templates, and scripts the setup as recipe steps.

In this video:
• How a content item becomes a search result
• Enable the Lucene and Search features
• Create a Lucene index of your content
• Choose the index of the search page in Site Search
• Grant the Anonymous role access to the index
• Try the search page
• Choose what is indexed with a custom full-text template
• Rebuild the index
• Change the results page with templates
• Script the setup with a recipe
